picks.title: This shirt is like an AI invisibility cloak
picks.excerpt: Designer Simon Weckert's garment uses a deliberately wacky pattern that works as camouflage against AI vision systems.
picks.rationale: Pattern design as a functional interface to machine perception — a concrete case of designing for the model as an audience.

picks.title: Structuring Variables in Figma
picks.excerpt: A practical scheme for organising Figma variables — primitives, semantic aliases, collections and modes — so a UI library stays scalable as projects grow.
picks.rationale: A named, closed set of variables is exactly what stops a generating agent from inventing values — token structure is the guardrail now, not housekeeping.

picks.title: The $3.4m Disney auction is a reminder of what AI concept art takes from us
picks.excerpt: A record-breaking auction of original Disney concept art becomes an argument about what disappears when concept work is generated rather than drawn.
picks.rationale: 컨셉 아트가 생성물로 대체될 때 무엇이 사라지는지를 3.4M 달러 디즈니 경매를 축으로 따진 글 — AI 이미지 도구를 쓰는 디자이너에게 직접 걸리는 craft 논점.

picks.title: A Measurement-First Workflow for Evaluating AI Interior Concepts
picks.excerpt: AI image systems produce plausible interiors that quietly break real dimensions; this proposes measuring the generated concept against the actual room before anyone falls in love with the render.
picks.rationale: Generated concepts look buildable and aren't — putting measurement before taste is the missing review step for AI visualisation.

picks.title: The Unlock | Product Mockups with Badal Patel
picks.excerpt: Badal Patel of Super Spicy studio walks through his product-mockup approach, combining Adobe Firefly generation with hands-on Photoshop work.
picks.rationale: A working graphic designer showing exactly where he lets Firefly in and where he doesn't — the practical division of labour, not the pitch.
